items.title: The Nue Co. expects fragrance to reach 85% of sales as Ulta fuels growth
items.summary: Two years ago, fragrance generated around 20% of The Nue Co.s sales. This year, the category is expected to reach 85%. Ulta partnership is fueling growth.

items.summary: Rare Beauty (Selena Gomez) is using story-first celebrity ambassador strategy. New ambassador Ella Bright featured. Brand continues strong DTC and Sephora performance.

items.summary: Victoria's Secret Pink targeting Gen-Z shoppers with holiday strategy. First mall destination for Gen-Z.

items.summary: Indie fragrance brand Influxious built on TikTok #PerfumeTok community, now landing at Sephora. Nigerian heritage storytelling resonating with NA consumers.

items.title: Marketplace Briefing: What is driving a surge in Amazon sales for 3 startups
items.summary: Multiple DTC startups reporting Amazon as key growth channel in 2026. Strong Amazon listings, SEO, and review velocity driving beauty startup revenue.

items.summary: US salon revenue declining as consumers extend visit intervals. DIY beauty and at-home skincare/haircare products benefiting from this shift.

items.title: Fragrance Boom: The Nue Co. fragrance category growing from 20% to 85% of sales via Ulta
items.summary: The Nue Co. fragrance category to reach 85% of sales in 2026 (up from 20% two years ago). Ulta partnership driving mainstream fragrance adoption. Wellness-positioned indie fragrance brands outperforming in NA. Keywords: fragrance, Ulta, wellness, DTC, scent.

items.summary: Influxious (black-owned, Nigerian heritage) built on TikTok #PerfumeTok community, now entering Sephora via Accelerate program. Social-first fragrance brands gaining serious retail traction in NA. Keywords: fragrance, TikTok, Sephora Accelerate, indie beauty, heritage brand.

items.summary: ProTransit launches Echelon brand - serum, sunscreen, primer targeting free radical damage. Biotech-backed science claims for anti-aging. NA market. Keywords: biotech skincare, serum, sunscreen, anti-aging, science-backed.

items.title: Amazon surging as key sales channel for beauty DTC startups in 2026
items.summary: Multiple DTC beauty startups reporting significant Amazon revenue in 2026. Strong review velocity, SEO optimization and Amazon Ads driving discoverability. Skincare and beauty top performing categories on Amazon. Keywords: Amazon, DTC, marketplace, beauty, sales surge.
